page.layout: One page of text, centred, large type in the upper half and a short block of lines lower down. No margin notes, running head, page number or signature. Mirrored show-through from the other side of the leaf is visible and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and low-contrast. The large upper lines are capitals, but I cannot read them letter by letter, so each line is marked illegible and the letter counts are estimates. The lower lines are smaller and also unreadable. The mirrored text in the middle and lower part of the page is show-through from the reverse and is excluded. A blue mark at the bottom-right edge and the binding shadow on the right are not printed text. The line division is approximate. A higher-resolution or better-contrast scan would be needed to transcribe this page.
